text: I needed a tooth extraction quickly and they were able to see me on the same day. I had the dentist who is currently there on Tuesdays and Sundays. The procedure took about 30 minutes,  but they made sure to keep me as comfortable as possible the whole time.  It was obviously very unpleasant,  and I'm terrible with any kind of dental pain, but whenever I felt pain they'd stop and  top up the anesthetic to ensure it was as pain free as possible.  I didn't get her name, but I thought she was very good.

The receptionists are friendly and good with customers.

However, I was disappointed with the dentist. I asked for scaling, but the whole procedure took only 15 minutes (or maybe less). They did clean the surface of my teeth, but not the inner gum pockets. And isn't scaling supposed to clean those pockets to remove debris? That part was left dirty.

The worst part? It cost 1,300 baht. Social security covered 900, but I still had to pay an extra 400 out of pocket.

Will I come back? Maybe but I'd try a different dentist. I've heard other customers are satisfied with other doctors there.
